method: Every assigned record was read from supplied primary-source page extracts. Continuation pages were read from the corresponding full local PDF text where the mechanism or criteria continued. Article bodies were individually authored; the assembly helper only attached metadata, headings, scope and source links to explicit prose.
scope: 2025 GM monitor explanations only. No file-level model matrix has been treated as per-code vehicle applicability. All drafts retain explicit calibration/controller scope. No article is published or presented as mechanic approval.

needsReview.issue: The printed/extracted small-range/large-range electrode-current expression is incomplete or ambiguous. The article explains the documented internal switcher check and enable conditions while omitting numeric range bounds.

The underspeed threshold is negative (< -115 rpm), with no signal encoding explanation. The article retains the limitation and does not infer reverse physical rotation or a universal positive underspeed threshold.

The generic too-low title, matured-response label and printed difference/threshold do not establish an unambiguous universal failure direction. The supported model comparison and cold-soak prerequisites are explained without inventing a pass/fail temperature.
The diagnostic enable is printed Disabled. The article explains the ACM2 response-timeout design but does not assert this supplied calibration enables it.

Condition 1 says hardware message faults = No Fault under a failure condition. The article flags the contradiction and uses the separately supported message-age/pulse/electrical-state branches without silently reversing the condition.
The diagnostic and channel are enabled but slave calibrated present is false. The article requires application/configuration confirmation and does not diagnose a missing optional actuator.

boundedSourceObservations.issue: Articles select specific 25OBDG07A Part 2 monitors and explicitly retain unresolved download-index/application-matrix filename mapping; no Corvette, engine or model applicability is inferred.
T87a open-circuit-to-circuit-low exceptions are explicit and preserved.
Source strategy describes full-load comparison while continuation has fuel-cut qualifications; article does not convert the mixed wording into a universal drive cycle.
A/B labels are not fully spelled out in strategy column; article bounds the comparison to the documented sensor-3 and sensor-2 qualification chain rather than inventing a wiring test.
Printed 0.5 ms sample basis conflicts with two seconds/four samples; article omits a derived timing procedure and explicitly notes the inconsistency.
Invalid printed supply inequality omitted; article states it is not a valid universal supply specification.
The strategy has a transmission copy/paste sentence; inertial component heading and actual HPID acceleration/yaw/status fields determine article scope.
Printed enable identifier differs from DTC; not used as independent applicability evidence.
Printed message-age unit is seconds (>100 s); articles explicitly retain it, distinguish it from the 100 ms task and avoid silently changing the units.
Different receiver/calibration variants have different count thresholds; each article selects and identifies one implementation rather than merging rules.
